keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: One or more seed keywords to expand, e.g. "project management software". Each seed is fanned out through the enabled modifiers.

source.title: Suggestion source
source.description: Where the autocomplete suggestions come from.

language.title: Language
language.description: Autocomplete language code, e.g. en, es, fr, de, pt.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two letter country code, e.g. us, gb, ca, au, in, de.

expandLetters.title: Expand with a to z suffixes
expandLetters.description: Query the seed followed by each letter ("seed a" ... "seed z"). The biggest source of long tail suggestions.

expandDigits.title: Expand with 0 to 9 suffixes
expandDigits.description: Query the seed followed by each digit. Useful for products, versions and years.

expandQuestions.title: Expand with question prefixes
expandQuestions.description: Query how/what/why/when/where/which/who/can/is/are/best in front of the seed. The rows content teams want.

expandPrepositions.title: Expand with preposition suffixes
expandPrepositions.description: Query the seed followed by for/with/without/vs/versus/near/like/to. Surfaces comparison and use case queries.

maxRowsPerKeyword.title: Max suggestions per seed
maxRowsPerKeyword.description: Cap on unique suggestion rows per seed keyword.

maxRows.title: Max rows total
maxRows.description: Maximum suggestion rows across all seeds. First 10 rows per run are free.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The endpoint is tolerant and requests are paced, so proxy is off by default. Supply one only if you run very large expansions and see rate limit warnings.
